en.headline: National Day fireworks set for 1 October over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: A 23-minute display of about 31,888 shells will begin at 8pm under the theme Eternal Radiance, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China.
body: The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau said on Wednesday that the 2026 National Day fireworks display will take place over Victoria Harbour at 8pm on 1 October.

The show, themed Eternal Radiance and lasting about 23 minutes, will launch 31,888 pyrotechnic shells from nine firing points on three barges and six pontoons. The overall budget is about HK$18 million and the display is exclusively sponsored by Sun Life Hong Kong.

Organisers said the programme is divided into eight scenes. Highlights include a second scene featuring layered golden and red ring patterns symbolising warmth and hope, a fourth scene with colour-changing spherical shells suggesting space travel, and a fifth scene with red heart and yellow star shapes.
RTHK Radio 4 will broadcast synchronised music during the display. Crowds are expected to gather at traditional viewing points such as Tsim Sha Tsui and Hung Hom.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演10月1日晚上8時維港上演
zh.dek: 為慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年，約31888枚煙花分八幕燃放23分鐘，主題為「永明煙花 綻放中華」。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局周三公布，2026年國慶煙花匯演將於10月1日晚上8時在維多利亞港上空舉行。
匯演以「永明煙花 綻放中華」為主題，歷時約23分鐘，動用三艘躉船及六艘小浮船，於九個發放點共發射31888枚煙花，整體預算約1800萬港元，由永明金融獨家贊助。
主辦單位表示，節目分為八幕。第二幕「驕陽送暖」首次呈現金色與紅色層層綻放的光環，象徵希望與溫暖；第四幕「有夢飛航」以七彩變幻球狀煙花營造星際景象；第五幕「擁抱愛」則以紅色心形及黃色星形煙花傳遞關愛。
香港電台第四台將同步播放背景音樂。市民可於尖沙咀、紅磡等地傳統觀賞點欣賞。
